_note: Reference tables from Colton's 'Asphalt Road Estimation Tool' sheet (Information tab). Shown in the app's Field guide. General trade information, no prices of ours.

asphalt.notes: High oil content, flexible, ideal for traffic-facing finish layer
Supports surface layer, optional top layer for low-traffic areas
Not exposed to traffic, must be paved over with another layer

base.name: SB-1 Gravel (with fines)
base.pros: Packs tight; smoother finish; easy to grade
base.cons: Can seal over and shed water slowly; slick when fines are wet
base.when: Top lift/cap over SB-2 for a tighter surface on drives and yards
base.life: Base lasts indefinitely with periodic surface dressing; regrade/top-up every 1–3 yrs
base.field: Keep moisture near optimum; provide crown/drainage

base.name: SB-2 Gravel (with fines)
base.pros: Great interlock from larger rock; strong base; drains better than tight fines
base.cons: Rougher riding surface; usually needs a finer cap
base.when: Primary base course before SB-1 or screenings cap
base.life: Long-term structural base with routine maintenance
base.field: Use separator fabric on clay to prevent pumping

base.name: Crushed Limestone Base (flex base)
base.pros: Predictable gradation; dense; excellent interlock; widely available
base.cons: Can pump in fat clays without separation; dusty when dry
base.when: General-purpose base under chip seal/hot mix; driveways, lots
base.life: 10–20+ yrs as base under maintained surface
base.field: Compact in ≤6 in lifts; specify well-graded

base.name: Crushed Concrete (with fines)
base.pros: Cost-effective; angular; can self-cement slightly; recycled
base.when: Budget base if supplier quality is good
base.field: Screen for contaminants; may add limestone fines

base.name: Crushed Iron-Ore Gravel (red rock)
base.pros: Very hard/durable; compacts firm; locally available
base.cons: Fines slick when wet; rust-stains; variable supply
base.when: Strong base when local pit is reliable
base.life: Long-term base; excellent under chip seal/hot mix
base.field: Control moisture; crown well for drainage

base.name: Decomposed/Crushed Granite
base.pros: Locks up tight; attractive color; premium look
base.cons: Ravel without binder; dusty in drought
base.life: Long-term base; if surface, dress every few yrs

base.name: #57 Stone + Screenings (crusher run)
base.pros: #57s form skeleton; fines lock voids; strong interlock
base.cons: Too few fines = won’t lock; too many = holds water
base.when: DIY flex base from quarry products

base.name: RAP (Recycled Asphalt Millings)
base.pros: Binds with heat/traffic; sheds water; economical
base.cons: Needs moisture/rolling; can track in heat
base.life: 3–7 yrs as surface; much longer as base

base.name: Asphalt-Stabilized Base (ASB)
base.pros: Cohesive; water-resistant; stronger than plain RAP

base.name: Asphalt (Hot Mix, wearing)
base.cons: Needs base support; cracks over time
base.field: Use prime coat on base, tack between lifts

base.name: Sand (bedding only)
base.cons: No structure; pumps in clay; holds water

liquids.use: Prime granular base before hot mix
liquids.warn: Highly flammable – apply with care. Cure fully before paving.

liquids.use: Used on base courses to seal and prep
liquids.warn: Watch VOC compliance. Avoid wet surfaces.
Do not use on frozen or overly saturated base.
Avoid overheating and poor surface contact.

liquids.cure: Cure: 30 min; open for traffic in 2 hrs
liquids.use: Faster cure tack coat for overlays
Standard emulsion-based tack for full bonding
liquids.warn: Requires agitation. Avoid applying over debris.

liquids.use: Protect asphalt from oil, sun, and water
liquids.warn: Banned in some states. Avoid overapplication.

liquids.coverage: Premium polymer; needs agitation and sand

liquids.use: Flexible heavy-duty sealant for busy lots
Penetrate and prep granular base for asphalt overlay
liquids.warn: Do not apply on saturated base. Avoid freezing temps.

liquids.cure: Cure: 12–24 hrs; test surface for dryness
liquids.use: Emulsified primer for light base seal

liquids.coverage: Light bond layer; not a sealcoat
liquids.use: Light bond or fog coat prep
liquids.warn: Do not confuse with tack coat. Limited bonding.

liquids.coverage: Turns black when cured; check surface
liquids.use: Bond between asphalt layers (roads, patches, overlays)
liquids.warn: Do not overheat. Let cure fully (turn black). Avoid wet surfaces.

liquids.coverage: Let dry fully; good for cold patch tack
liquids.use: Standard slow-set tack for base bond
liquids.warn: Let dry before paving. Avoid low temps.

liquids.use: Light tack for overlays or patching
liquids.warn: Avoid pooling or contamination on surface.

liquids.cure: Cure: 24 hrs; avoid rain within 12 hrs
liquids.warn: Do not apply to fresh asphalt. Avoid rain.
Don’t apply under 50°F. Mix before use.

liquids.cure: Cure: 24 hrs; needs warmth and sunlight
